---
title: "revealjs: tabsets"
format: revealjs
# A `.panel-tabset` in a deck becomes Quarto 1's Tabby markup: a
# `ul.panel-tabset-tabby` of links followed by a `div.tab-content` of panes.
# The tab headings are consumed, an `.active` heading marks the default tab,
# a nested tabset takes the next id, and the deck loads Tabby. The last three
# slides are the cases of Quarto 1's
# tests/docs/playwright/revealjs/tabset-focus-order.qmd.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'section div.panel-tabset > ul#tabset-1.panel-tabset-tabby'
          - 'ul#tabset-1 > li > a[data-tabby-default][href="#tabset-1-1"]'
          - 'ul#tabset-1 > li > a[href="#tabset-1-2"]:not([data-tabby-default])'
          - 'div.panel-tabset > div.tab-content > div#tabset-1-1'
          - 'div.panel-tabset > div.tab-content > div#tabset-1-2'
          - 'ul#tabset-2 > li > a[data-tabby-default][href="#tabset-2-2"]'
          - 'div#tabset-3-1 div.panel-tabset > ul#tabset-4.panel-tabset-tabby'
          - 'div#tabset-4-1'
          - 'ul#tabset-5 > li > a > code'
          - 'script[src$="tabby.js"]'
          - 'script[src$="tabby-init.js"]'
        - - 'div.panel-tabset h2'
          - 'div.panel-tabset > div.tab-content > h3'
          - 'ul.nav-tabs'
          - 'a[data-bs-toggle]'
          - 'div.tab-pane'
---
